about_short_description.short_description: Eli Lilly is a pharma company focused on developing medicines for diabetes, cancer, immunology, and other major health areas.

product.name: Mounjaro (tirzepatide)
product.description: A prescription injectable medicine used with diet and exercise to improve blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes.

product.name: Zepbound (tirzepatide)
product.description: A prescription injectable medicine used with diet and physical activity for chronic weight management in eligible adults and adolescents.

product.name: Verzenio (abemaciclib)
product.description: An oral targeted cancer medicine used for certain types of hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer.

product.name: Taltz (ixekizumab)
product.description: An injectable biologic medicine used to treat several inflammatory conditions, including plaque psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, and axial spondyloarthritis.

product.name: Trulicity (dulaglutide)
product.description: A once-weekly injectable GLP-1 receptor agonist used with diet and exercise to improve blood sugar control in adults and some pediatric patients with type 2 diabetes.

product.name: Humalog (insulin lispro)
product.description: A rapid-acting insulin used to control blood sugar in people with diabetes, including type 1 and type 2 diabetes.
